description: This file contains CMake functions related to creating and registering new events. It defines two versions of the 'event_new' function for creating event objects, setting event properties, and globally registering them within the build system. The functions facilitate event creation, registration, and handling in CMake scripts, possibly for a larger build or application framework.

methods.name: event_new
methods.description: Creates a new event object with a specified or generated ID, sets up event handling functions, and registers the event globally within the build system. Two implementations are provided: one using 'curry3' to create callable functions and another using explicit nested 'function' definitions and 'eval' to generate functions dynamically.
